name: Valley Chevrolet — AI Receptionist
description: One scenario that does everything: receives a customer message, gets an AI reply from Claude, sends the reply back to the customer, and emails your team with a summary if contact info was collected.

metadata.notes: STEP 1 — This receives the customer's message. Make will give you a unique URL to paste into your chat widget or contact form.

mapper.body: {"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","max_tokens":512,"system":"You are Alex, the friendly AI receptionist for Valley Chevrolet Service Center in Wilkes-Barre PA. Be warm, brief, and helpful. Hours: Mon-Fri 7:30am-6pm, Sat 7:30am-4pm, closed Sunday. Address: 700 Kidder St, Wilkes-Barre PA 18702. Services: oil changes, tires, brakes, diagnostics, AC, battery, state inspection, GM recalls (free), loaner cars. Never quote firm prices. Collect name, phone, email, vehicle, and service need for appointments.","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"{{1.message}}"}]}

metadata.notes: STEP 2 — Sends the message to Claude AI and gets Alex's reply.
STEP 4 — Sends Alex's reply back to the customer's chat widget.

mapper.subject: New customer inquiry via AI Receptionist
mapper.content:
New Customer Message

Customer message:
{{1.message}}

Alex replied:
{{3.content[].text}}

Follow up with the customer if they left their contact info above.

metadata.notes: STEP 5 — Emails your team a summary of every conversation.

_setup_notes.step_1_webhook: After importing, click the webhook module and Make will generate a unique URL. Copy it — this is what your website chat widget will send messages to.
_setup_notes.step_2_api_key: Replace {{ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}} with your key from console.anthropic.com
_setup_notes.step_3_gmail: Connect your Gmail account in Make. Replace {{GMAIL_CONNECTION_ID}} with the connection name.
_setup_notes.step_4_emails: Replace {{ADVISOR_EMAIL}} with where you want notifications sent (e.g. service@valleychevrolet.com). Replace {{FROM_EMAIL}} with the same address.
_setup_notes.step_5_test: Click 'Run once', then send a test message to your webhook URL. Check that you get a reply and receive the email notification.
